content: Jaa joi nincacax tiromayamascanahue. Paranyamascanahue, ni pishcabi. Hahxonquin quesajayamascanahue, notsi notsihax joni huetsa qui yohuanyamascai.
Rahma cainipish baquexo xoma jene queenihcamahi hahan haniti joi queennahue, Criston jihuetahbo sca hanicananoxon.
Matohon jaan hihti shinanai tah man honanquin sirijaribiscai.
Cristo noquen hahqui xobojati
Hahqui xobojati jihuibo caisxon tiromabo potaquin hahcajaquin Cristo potanihbo que bi ta siri bi res Papan jaa caisihqui, mohitahpa jihui. Hahquibi sca nocóhihnanahue.

Mohitahpa hahan jan xobojahi quescapahbo janahue, jahuen xobo sca. Jahuen xobohoxon shinanmanicabo jai quescarihbihi jahuen joi yohinicabo janahue. Hahan Papa Dios jenimatibo hinanquin hahcajaquin Papa queenai quescajaquin hahxonnahue Jesucristo betan.
Papan huishamani joi janin ta nea jaiqui:

content.text: Jise, heen jonibo tocan tah hen hean caisai jihui nichinhihni sca jai, siri bi res hahqui xobojati siri. Jaa nincacoinaibo ta tsoanbi hihtimahmatimahihqui

content: hihqui jaa joi.
Jaa copi ta jaa hihti siri qui, man nincacoinaibaan jisi. Nincayosmabo yohihi ta huetsa huishani joi jaribihiqui:

content.text: Xobojahibaan queenyamaxon potani jihui ta hahqui xobojati sca jaiqui

content: hihqui.
Huetsa rihbi:

content.text: Jonibo hahqui joxcorohti jihui tah qui, hahqui jonibo joxcorohti tobiti jihui

content: hihqui. Papan joi nincacatsihyamahax joxcorohtax paquetihcamajaquin jaamajaquin. Jaabaan jascajayaxihqui ta Papan yohinishqui.
Papan baquebo

Jaabo jascapahbo que bi ta Papan caisaibo mato qui. Quiquin hapo bebonxon yohuanxonnicahbo sca tah man qui, Papa Dios qui jonibo nocomanoxon. Papan jonibo sca tah man qui, jahuen baquecoinbo sca. Bahquish chian man jihuetai bi ta mato quenanishqui, jahuen siri xabapan man jihuenon. Noque ta sirijaquin hahxonihqui, hih man janon yohihi.
Jahuama hihpahonish bi tah man Papan baqueboscai. Mato bihyamanixon bi ta rahma Papan mato sirijaquin sca bichiqui.
Papan shinanya non jihueti jai

Matohon shinanxon tah hen mato yohihi: Maton main tah man jihueyamahi. Mai mehabaan nahuabo sca tah man qui. Jascapahbohax tah man mai meha shinanbo man queentimascai. Jascapa shinaman ta tiroma yoshiman mato bichiqui, mato hahbetan hiocatsihquin.

Nahua tocan jihuetaibohax sirijaquin shinanax jihuenahue. Jaatian ta mato qui jaabo tiromahi yohuanax bi noquen Hihbo jores sca jaiya sca man joni huetsa yanapanai jisnish, Papa Diosen ta jato jahuen shinan hinannishqui, hihyaxihcanihqui.
Noquen Hihbaan joniboxon jatihibi hapobo nincanahue.
Quiquin hapo rihbi nincaquin. Jaan raanai tinintibo rihbi nincarihbiquin. Tiromajahibo casticannon ta jaabo raanihqui. Siribo rihbi yohihi, Jaa ta siribo qui jaahbo hihxon jato raanquin.
Honanyamahax yohuanresaiboxon bi ta honanma jonibaan mato shinancoinyabohi jisish netetihiqui. Jascati ta Papa queenihqui.
Hiná quescapahboma sca janahue. Hinabo hihyamascaxon bi tah man tiromajatimahi. Papan hahxontibo sca jihuenahue.
Jatihibi jonibo yohuanquihnxon nincanahue. Noquen huetsabohon shinannahue, Papa qui tiromati qui raquexon. Noquen quiquin hapo rihbi shinannahue.
Criston teneni quescajaquin non tenetihi
Patoroyahpaxon maton patoronen yohihah nincanahue, jato shinanquin. Maton patoro siri jaiya jaa shinanquin sirijaquin. Tiroma patoro jaiya shinanrihbiquin.
Man siripi jihuetai bi tiromajaquin shinanxon caibaan mato casticana bi noquen Papahon shinanxon man teneresaiya ta Papan mato siri jisiqui.

Man tiromahiboya mato rishqui rishquihahbo ta man tenehi que bi noquen Papan mato siri jistimahiqui. Man ponte res jihuetai copi caibaan sca mato tiromajahah bi man shinanquin sirijaxon teneresaiya pari ta Papan mato siri jisiqui.
Matohon shinanxon ta tiromabo Criston tenenishqui. Jaan teneni quescajaribiti ta Papan mato yohihihqui.
Cristo ta hohchayamanishqui. Jaan ta jahuentianbi paranyamanishqui.
Tiromajaquin joinjahabo bi joi bichinyamaquin. Tiromajahahbaan bi jato tahtijayamaquin. Sirijaquin shinanxon casticannica noquen Papa jai honanxon jaan teneresquin, Papan jato jisnon.

Jihuin hueonahbo hueoxon ta jaanbi noquen hohcha bihnishqui, jahuen yora janin. Mahuascaibo hohchayosma hihqui quescapahbo non hohchayamascanon ta jaa mahuanishqui, sirijahibo sca non jihuenon. Jahuen tsehueyaxon ta mato sohuaxon jihuemahiqui.
Carnerobo quescapahbo tah man janiqui, behnoti. Behnonish bi rahma maton coirannicah qui nocorihbiscai, maton jihuemanicah qui nocoscai.
